newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Nissan head sees steady Japanese car policy.
newsitem.headline: Nissan head sees steady Japanese car policy.

text.p: Japanese carmakers will stick by globalisation plans "regardless of short-term fluctuations" in currency exchange rates, said Yoshifumi Tsuji, Chairman of Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association and Nissan Motor Co Ltd.

"Our companies continue to expand their investment in plants here. We obtain more than 80 percent of our parts and materials from local suppliers," according to a Tsuji speech due to be delivered later on Wednesday.

"Employment at our European operations continues to grow and we are bringing technology through local design and development," he said in the speech released to reporters ahead of delivery to a JAMA-hosted reception.

"Import sales in Japan last year were up more than 10 percent over the previous year. A global competition between Japanese and foreign automakers will be in high gear, even in the Japanese market," he said.
